title: Divergence: contract_tv::is_rlimit_signal is a drifted copy of body_tv's — drops the 'resource limit exceeded' clause, so a Z3-phrased resourceout ('max. resource limit exceeded', literal in the distributed z3 binary) on an errors>=1 run is fabricated into ClauseVerdict::Divergent (the exact #189-class false finding the #166 fix claims to close)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing tests at forge/tests/divergence_rlimit_phrase_drift.rs::{divergence_contract_tv_rlimit_phrases_drifted_from_body_tv, divergence_z3_resourceout_phrase_escapes_contract_tv_rlimit_gate} demonstrate the divergence (run with -- --ignored). contract_tv's phrase set is ["rlimit exceeded", "rlimit) exceeded"]; body_tv's (#189 authority) adds "resource limit exceeded", which is what catches Z3's own resourceout literal 'max. resource limit exceeded' (present in the distributed z3 binary). Fix: add the third clause to contract_tv::is_rlimit_signal, then un-ignore both pins.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Plan: pin the drift with two #[ignore]d failing tests at forge/tests/divergence_rlimit_phrase_drift.rs (source-seam extraction of the contains() phrase literals — the fns are private to the forge bin and a real Z3 rlimit hit is not deterministically forcible), citing body_tv::is_rlimit_signal (#189) + the z3 binary literal 'max. resource limit exceeded' as authority; commit on main per critic discipline. Fix is the generator's: add the 'resource limit exceeded' clause to contract_tv::is_rlimit_signal, then un-ignore.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: FIXED at root cause + re-critic-clean (4509f1a2). ONE shared forge/src/tv_signal.rs::is_rlimit_signal (3 phrases incl. resource-limit-exceeded catching z3's 'max. resource limit exceeded' literal); contract_tv + body_tv copies deleted (clean replacements, faithful/counterexample/frame-abort arms byte-unchanged); exec_tv gains its previously-MISSING rlimit gate (Unverifiable ahead of Divergent; the deliberate #122/#146 non-compile->Divergent catch byte-identical). The pins un-ignored + adapted: the oracle now a hand-written #189-authority constant (stronger than the original live-source comparison) + a no-per-phase-copy invariant (drift cannot recur). 487 forge tests 0 failed.
